a_official_trades.what: the ten official sleeves rebuilt from the cut frames (FP costs, one position, no refusal, as r2/recalc.py) against results/r2/recalc/trades read with entry_time < CUT (counts) and entry_time, exit_time < CUT (results); targets from synthesis_B first_check_rule2. The official rows still open at the cut (one donch4h_stop, one orb_asia_2d_buf10 gold trade, closed in 2022 officially) are counted, never read; their in-frame twins close at the last bar.

b_K1.what: K1 (brk72_24h_wd ethusd, riskbp skip refitted every 1 January) against synthesis_B sleeve_runs C1 (fp and x1.5), every field; the harness's walk-forward (any CUT) against s1_run.walk_forward

c_K2_K3.what: K2 and K3: the frozen gold orb_asia_2d_buf10 on ethusd and btcusd as new sleeves, against synthesis_B sleeve_runs N1 / N2 (fp and x1.5; the trade still open at the end of 2021 dropped)

d_payoff_variants.what: the seven payoff variants in play (and their references) against results/r2/autopsy/payoff/variants_table.csv (fp and x1.5 columns, common window 2018-02-01..2021-12-31, earlier entries, refusals, years better) and the lens's trials.jsonl (by year, censored trades, H extensions); review F6: the references with the payoff lens's 3-spread refusal, identical to the sB sleeves trade by trade inside the window (lab, fp and x1.5; live reported)

e_portfolios_P0_P1_P2.what: the synthesis_B portfolios P0 (ten unchanged), P1 (ten with K1), P2 (ten with K1 + K2 + K3), fp and x1.5, plain sum at 1 R per trade, entries 2018-02-01..2021-12-31, server weeks: every field of synthesis_B.json portfolio.results; and the harness's metrics equal to synthesis_B's own s2_portfolio.metrics (imported) on the same book

f_capped_account.what: the capped account (6 positions, 2 per market; stake 0 takes no slot): identical to the cluster lens's run_engine on the harness's own P0 / P2 books, and on the cluster lens's own trades it reproduces engine_check.json and r2/tracks/stake/account.py (1e9 EUR account, no lot / margin effect)

g_live_execution.what: the live execution (entry one minute late at market, Friday 16:50 New York close): K2 run this way reproduces the verifiers' figures quoted in synthesis_B (392 trades, +142.1 R; x1.5 +127.9 R) and the harness's declared default is that run without the trade still open at the end of 2021; the alternative chain resolver ('rule') returns the official chain trade for trade when there is no delay and no Friday close, and differs from the default only by signals at the previous trade's exit minute; review F7: the Friday block tested on the decision instant as well (a synthetic order shows the rule acting; no in-sample signal is concerned)

h_stakes.what: the stake interface (Addendum I hook): stake 1 reproduces P0 in both accounts; a sleeve-year table adds exactly its sleeve-year R; a walk-forward stake refitted every 1 January uses only outcomes known before 1 January minus 7 days and stays within [0, 2]

i_guard.what: the guard of the harness (vhi_guard): F1 the declaration bound to the spec (PROTOCOL_V3.md as it stands refused), F2 run once / fixed output / second access, F3 the hardened read guard (probes refused before any byte is read), CUT rules, the access log untouched, every read of the process with its filter

j_entry_point_rehearsal.what: the look's entry point (look.py) run end to end at CUT 2022-01-01 in its own process with the spec as it stands (changes_in_look K1, K2, K3): the right sleeves, portfolios and verdicts, the same numbers as the proofs' run, nothing logged

k_moving_the_cut.what:
MOVING THE CUT, as the look will: the same spec run by look.py at CUT 2021-01-01 (in sample) must give, for
every sleeve, chain, cost mode and execution, exactly the trades of the CUT 2022-01-01 run that entered and
closed inside the shorter frame -- the harness's results do not depend on where the frame ends except for the
trades it cannot finish. K1's fit for the year starting at that CUT must be the CUT-2022 run's 2021 fold.

l_verdicts.what:
F10: the verdicts block. Every criterion value equals the run's own statistic (rounded as the run reports it)
and synthesis_B's published figure where there is one; a change without a declared criterion is reported as
such. In sample the verdicts only check the machinery (the window is 2018-02 .. 2021-12, not the look's).
